doc_title_en: Notification of upward revision of earnings forecast and modification of dividend forecast (dividend increase) for FY8/12
doc_title_jp: 業績予想の上方修正、配当予想の修正（増配）に関するお知らせ

key_facts.reason_jp: 業績上方修正を踏まえ、株主還元と段階的配当方針

summary_en: Annual dividend raised from ¥80/share to ¥105/share (31.3% increase), comprising ordinary dividend of ¥105 (vs prior ¥80) paid as single year-end distribution. Increase follows upward revision of FY8/12 earnings; management targeting 30%+ payout ratio and progressive dividend policy.
summary_jp: 年間配当を1株当たり¥80から¥105に引き上げ(31.3%増加)。期末配当として1回払い。通期業績上方修正を受け、配当性向30%以上を目安に段階的増配方針に沿う。
